instruction: The slide numbers in my presentation need better visibility. Please change them to black to make them more professional and easier to read.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color to black in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the slide master XML to verify the page number placeholder color has been changed to black (RGB with all components < threshold). Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies page number placeholder using semantic XML attribute matching (p:ph[@type='sldNum']) rather than positional indexing.
Proper fallback logic to check footer placeholder (p:ph[@type='ftr']) if page number placeholder not found in expected location.
Color validation logic is correct: is_black() function checks all RGB components are below threshold (50), which accurately identifies black colors.
Complete coverage: verifies the single requirement that slide numbers should be changed to black.
Edge case handling: returns 0.0 if color not found, gracefully handles XML parsing errors, zipfile errors, and missing elements.
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before evaluation to ensure changes are persisted to the PPTX file.
Data flow is semantically correct: file saved → retrieved → parsed → page number placeholder located by type → color extracted → validated as black.
